title: Local association of mregDC-like and T-cell/lymphoid transcriptional programs in PDAC
description: Code, derived results, figures, and manuscript sources for a public-data study of a specified local association between mregDC-like and T-cell/lymphoid transcriptional programs in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma. Raw GEO data are not redistributed.
